Name: No More Floor Fish - Jodi Event Edit
Author: AirynS
Description:
Like the name suggests, this mod edits Jodi's 4 heart event so that the farmer doesn't throw a fresh, slimy fish onto Jodi's living room floor, because what the heck, farmer. Instead, the event now takes place in the kitchen and the farmer will place the fish onto Jodi's kitchen counter like a civilised person. It also tweaks Sam's dialogue so that he's a little happier to help out (though not overjoyed at the idea of cleaning a fish).

As an additional feature, No More Floor Fish also prevents Jodi's heart event from triggering until Year 2 when Kent returns, so that players can see the Kent variation of the event without feeling bad for leaving Jodi hanging for months. This is set to true by default but can be disabled.

[size=4][b]INSTALLATION
[/b][/size]
This mod requires Content Patcher.

To install, simply unzip the "[CP] No More Floor Fish" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

[b][size=4]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b]

No More Floor Fish may or may not have errors with mods that change the interior map for Sam's house. If it has issues with a mod that is not SVE, let me know and I'll see how difficult compatibility will be. [b]If it has bugs with SVE, I will not add compatibility. Requests or complaints about SVE will be deleted.

[/b]Seasonal outfits and Jodi's mermaid pendant in screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url].
